text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes, Grass 
Wonder delivered just as promised... no, 
an even greater performance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd was buzzing, and it seemed as 
though they were showering her with 
endless praise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In truth, however—

text_block_list.name: Child in the Audience
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing... So that's Grass 
Wonder, the one they call the "Monster 
II", right Dad?!

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan
text_block_list.text:
"There's definitely something 
extraordinary about her. She reminds me of 
Maruzensky in her Junior days."

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan
text_block_list.text:
The explosive roar that erupted from the 
stands when she set that record... It 
still echoes in my ears even now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a great race! The words for my 
article are just pouring out of me...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
We've got to pick good photos too! Oh, I 
know! Wouldn't it be super touching if we 
line them up to overlap with Maruzensky's 
past self...?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—It's something I understood rationally. I 
was even able to anticipate it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However... now that I'm feeling it 
firsthand like this...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. I'm totally fine~, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's just—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"The name ‘Maruzensky’ was far more 
colossal than anyone could have imagined."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I trained relentlessly so as not to leave 
a single vulnerability. I gave everything 
I had to meet this challenge.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I am still the "second 
generation." What people envision is that 
crimson attire.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...There is no way I could possibly be 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Even so, merely tracing the footsteps of 
the past would only lead to being consumed 
by the greatness of that name.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If so, then all that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's no other choice but to challenge 
them directly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder nodded silently. In her eyes 
burned a fierce, unyielding flame...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“No Retreat.” That is what I vowed, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us prepare thoroughly. No matter how 
much we train, it will never feel like 
enough against this opponent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
First, let us hone ourselves as much as 
possible in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I definitely want to win the 
Japanese Derby, the race that crowns the 
pinnacle of the Classic generation.
choice_data_list: Then let's make the Derby our next goal!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"‘Where there is a will, there is a way.’ 
No matter how great a predecessor she may 
be... I will surpass her, without fail!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, to prepare for the showdown with 
Maruzensky, setting our sights on the 
Derby came first!
